(1) "Report of UFO Crash in '47 Called False by Science Panel." New York Times. August 26, 1987
(2) Sangeorge, Robert. "UFO Group Wants Secret Documents." UPI. August 26, 1987
doc_notes: This document consists of news reports detailing the debunking of forged documents regarding a 1947 UFO crash and alien recovery.

encounters.summary: Alleged 1947 crash of a flying saucer and recovery of four alien bodies, presented in documents identified as fraudulent by a science panel.
encounters.quote: the Pentagon recovered a crashed flying saucer and the bodies of four alien creatures in 1947
